arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
sahihInternational: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
yusufAli: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
urdu: اور ہم نے کوئی بستی ہلاک نہیں کی۔ مگر اس کا وقت مرقوم ومعین تھا

arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
sahihInternational: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
yusufAli: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
urdu: اور ہمارے ہاں ہر چیز کے خزانے ہیں اور ہم ان کو بمقدار مناسب اُتارتے رہتے ہیں

sahihInternational: Until the Day of the time well-known."
yusufAli: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
urdu: وقت مقرر (یعنی قیامت) کے دن تک

sahihInternational: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
yusufAli: So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,
urdu: تو جادوگر ایک مقررہ دن کی میعاد پر جمع ہوگئے

arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
sahihInternational: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
yusufAli: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed.
urdu: صالح نے کہا (دیکھو) یہ اونٹنی ہے (ایک دن) اس کی پانی پینے کی باری ہے اور ایک معین روز تمہاری باری

sahihInternational: Those will have a provision determined -
yusufAli: For them is a Sustenance determined,
urdu: یہی لوگ ہیں جن کے لئے روزی مقرر ہے

arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
sahihInternational: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
yusufAli: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
urdu: اور (فرشتے کہتے ہیں کہ) ہم میں سے ہر ایک کا ایک مقام مقرر ہے

sahihInternational: Until the Day of the time well-known."
yusufAli: "Till the Day of the Time Appointed."
urdu: اس روز تک جس کا وقت مقرر ہے

sahihInternational: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
yusufAli: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
urdu: (سب) ایک روز مقرر کے وقت پر جمع کئے جائیں گے

sahihInternational: And those within whose wealth is a known right
yusufAli: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
urdu: اور جن کے مال میں حصہ مقرر ہے

yusufAli: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
